name: Portable Electric Heating Lunch Box with Leak-Proof Design & Soup Tray
description:
Enjoy fresh, warm meals on the go with this Portable Electric Heating Lunch Box. Built with food-grade, heat-resistant materials and a concealed PTC heater, it warms food evenly in minutes — no microwave required. Lightweight and portable, it’s perfect for school, office, or travel use.

Key Features
Made with heat-resistant, food-safe materials
Concealed PTC heater for quick heating
Leak-proof lid with anti-spill design
Lightweight and portable for daily use
Includes separate soup tray with lid
Energy-efficient and easy to operate

Ingredients / Materials
High-temperature-resistant food-grade plastic, stainless steel inner tray, PTC heating element

How to Use
Place food inside stainless steel tray
Secure lid tightly with anti-leak seals
Plug into power source and wait for heating
Enjoy freshly warmed meals anywhere

Package Includes
1 × Electric Heating Lunch Box
1 × Stainless Steel Food Tray
1 × Soup Tray with Lid
1 × Power Cable
